title: Homogeneous spin reconstruction from geometrically realizable highly supersymmetric filtered subdeformations with closed isotropy
source_version: Official SIGMA 21 (2025) journal PDF and native TeX; acquired 2026-09-30; exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The reconstruction must integrate the even data with closed isotropy, choose a global homogeneous spin lift, and realize the odd subspace as parallel equivariant sections whose current and transport data match the prescribed filtered brackets. The Spencer-cocycle and Killing-transport constructions are retained, so the task is more than applying Wang’s theorem to an already constructed background.
author: Andrew D.K. Beckett
